one_line: Kvasir-VQA-x1 turns atomic GI-endoscopy QAs into 159,549 expert-validated, complexity-stratified multimodal demonstrations for clinical VQA training and robustness evaluation.
Kvasir-VQA-x1 将胃肠内镜原子问答扩展为 159,549 条经专家验证、按复杂度分层的多模态示范，用于临床视觉问答训练和鲁棒性评估。
why: Existing gastrointestinal VQA data emphasizes atomic recognition and offers limited compositional reasoning or controlled robustness testing.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Existing gastrointestinal VQA data emphasizes atomic recognition and offers limited compositional reasoning or controlled robustness testing.

Kvasir-VQA-x1 groups atomic Kvasir-VQA pairs by image, samples one to three facts, and uses Qwen3-30B-A3B to merge questions and naturalize answers before clinical-expert validation. The decision boundary is whether the released image-question-answer record is a reusable supervised target with explicit source provenance and complexity, rather than an evaluation prompt or model-only artifact.

已有胃肠内镜视觉问答数据偏重原子识别，对组合推理和受控鲁棒性测试的支持有限。

Kvasir-VQA-x1 按图像汇集原始问答，抽取一至三个事实，再由大模型合并问题并自然化答案，最后经过临床专家验证。判定边界是公开的图像问题回答记录能否成为带明确来源和复杂度的可复用监督目标，而不是只有评测提示或只有模型产物。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
Kvasir-VQA-x1 turns one to three atomic findings about the same endoscopy image into a coherent clinical question and naturalized answer while retaining complexity and source-QA provenance. Relative to the atomic Kvasir-VQA baseline, it makes an image, complexity, merged question, answer, original QA list, question classes, and image id the reusable target and uses trivial-item removal, structural checks, expert validation, and controlled visual perturbations as the quality contract, so its central contribution is multimodal instruction data rather than a benchmark-only score table.

title: Method
方法
html:
Step 1 - Group and clean the source QAs. Input: Kvasir-VQA atomic questions, short answers, question classes, and a shared endoscopy image id. Operation: Group all pairs by image and remove predefined trivial or empty questions before composition. Output and transition: A per-image pool of clinically meaningful atomic facts advances to sampling. Check / stop rule: Stop if image provenance is missing or the surviving pool cannot support a valid question.

Step 2 - Compose the supervised target. Input: One, two, or three distinct atomic QAs sampled from one image. Operation: Use a local Qwen3-30B-A3B server to naturalize short answers and merge multi-fact questions into one coherent prompt with strict JSON-encodable structure. Output and transition: A candidate record receives complexity 1, 2, or 3 and retains its original atomic QA list. Check / stop rule: Reject copied raw answers, malformed structure, ambiguous references, clinically irrelevant combinations, or a mismatch between complexity and source count.

Step 3 - Validate and package visual variants. Input: Candidate question-answer records, original images, and clinical question classes. Operation: Apply expert validation, assign original train/test membership, and pair construction examples with original or weakly augmented images while releasing original images plus deterministic augmentation scripts. Output and transition: Passing records form 143,594 training and 15,955 test examples for standard and transformed settings. Check / stop rule: Reject semantic drift or duplicate QA instances across splits; keep augmented pixels reproducible rather than presenting them as separate canonical records.

Step 4 - Train and evaluate consumers. Input: The versioned records and MedGemma or Qwen2.5-VL checkpoints. Operation: Fine-tune with LoRA and evaluate using text-overlap metrics plus aspect-wise Qwen3-30B-A3B adjudication on original and transformed images. Output and transition: Model checkpoints, aggregate metrics, category scores, and complexity-level diagnostics become the reported evidence. Check / stop rule: Pin the data split, image transform seed, checkpoint, clinical prompt, and judge version; do not interpret judge scores as clinical deployment validation.

Reproduction requires the official dataset revision, source Kvasir-VQA images, generation prompt, teacher decoding settings, expert-validation protocol, augmentation seed, LoRA configuration, and adjudicator endpoint; undisclosed values remain unknown.

步骤 1——汇集并清理来源问答。 输入：原始内镜问题、短答案、问题类别和共享图像编号。 操作：按图像汇集所有问答，并在组合前删除预定义的琐碎或空问题。 输出及流转：每张图像对应的一组有临床意义的原子事实进入抽样阶段。 检查与停止规则：图像来源缺失，或保留池无法支持有效问题时停止。

步骤 2——组合监督目标。 输入：从同一图像抽取的一、二或三个不同原子问答。 操作：用本地部署的大模型自然化短答案，并把多事实问题合并为一个连贯提示，同时遵守严格的可解析结构。 输出及流转：候选记录获得一至三级复杂度，并保留原始问答列表。 检查与停止规则：直接复制原答案、结构错误、指代含糊、组合缺少临床意义，或复杂度与来源数量不符时拒绝。

步骤 3——验证并打包视觉变体。 输入：候选问答、原始图像和临床问题类别。 操作：执行专家验证，继承原始训练测试归属，并在构造时混合原图和弱增强图；公开版本保留原图并提供可复现增强脚本。 输出及流转：通过记录组成 143,594 条训练样本和 15,955 条测试样本，用于标准和变换设置。 检查与停止规则：语义发生漂移或同一问答跨切分重复时拒绝；增强像素应可重建，不应冒充新的规范记录。

步骤 4——训练并评估消费者。 输入：固定版本记录和两个公开医学或通用视觉语言基础模型。 操作：用低秩适配微调，再在原图与变换图上结合文字重合指标和按临床方面评分的大模型裁判进行评估。 输出及流转：模型检查点、总指标、类别分数和复杂度诊断形成论文证据。 检查与停止规则：固定切分、图像变换种子、模型、临床指令和裁判版本；裁判分数不能解释成临床部署验证。

复现需要固定官方数据版本、原始图像、生成提示、教师解码、专家验证流程、增强种子、微调配置和裁判端点；未披露参数保持未知。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Experiment 1: Table 5 reports 85.91% held-out training-subset evaluation accuracy for transformed-data Qwen2.5-VL and 84.97% for transformed-data MedGemma after LoRA fine-tuning; Table 6 shows Qwen fine-tuning raising normal-set ROUGE-L from 0.193 to 0.690 and BERT-F1 from 0.875 to 0.954 at the reported checkpoint.

Experiment 2: Aspect-wise Qwen3 adjudication gives overall mean accuracies of about 90% for fine-tuned Qwen2.5-VL and 87% for fine-tuned MedGemma, versus roughly 30-45% for their base checkpoints. Transformed-data variants change key normal-versus-transformed metrics by only about 0.001-0.002, while the paper also notes that some level-2 categories outperform level 1 because merged questions can reduce ambiguity.

实验 1：表 5 报告，在训练数据中留出的评估子集上，使用变换图微调的通用视觉语言模型准确率为 85.91%，医学模型为 84.97%；表 6 显示同一通用模型微调后，原图验证集的长序列重合指标从 0.193 升至 0.690，语义表示指标从 0.875 升至 0.954。

实验 2：按临床方面的大模型裁判给出，微调后的通用模型平均准确率约为 90%，微调后的医学模型约为 87%，而各自基础检查点约为 30% 至 45%。用变换数据训练的版本在原图和变换图之间，多项关键指标仅相差约 0.001 至 0.002；论文也指出部分二级问题优于一级问题，因为合并上下文可能减少歧义。

title: Novelty
新意
html: The closest baseline is Kvasir-VQA with approximately 58,849 mostly atomic QA pairs. Kvasir-VQA-x1 changes the reusable target by composing co-occurring clinical facts into 159,549 complexity-labeled questions, naturalizing their answers, retaining original-QA provenance, and pairing the release with reproducible perturbation scripts and expert validation. This is a direction signal because another team can directly fine-tune a VLM or build a curriculum from the public records. The underlying 6,500 images, source annotations, LLM rewriting, LoRA, standard VQA metrics, and weak image augmentations are inherited rather than individually novel.
最近基线是约含 58,849 条原子问答的原始胃肠内镜视觉问答集。本文真正改变的是把同现的临床事实组合成 159,549 条带复杂度的问题，自然化答案，保留原始问答来源，并配套可复现扰动脚本和专家验证。另一团队可以直接用公开记录微调视觉语言模型或构建课程，因此这是数据方向信号。底层 6,500 张图像、来源标注、大模型改写、低秩微调、常规视觉问答指标和弱图像增强均是继承组件。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. A Qwen3 teacher both composes records and later adjudicates model answers, so correlated preferences or semantic errors can survive despite expert validation.
  2. Complexity counts merged facts rather than guaranteed reasoning depth; added context can make some level-2 questions less ambiguous than level 1, and binary aspect scoring omits partial credit.
  3. The data covers 6,500 gastrointestinal images, inherits source-class imbalance, and uses a non-commercial license, limiting clinical, cross-specialty, and commercial generalization.

1. 同一系列大模型既组合记录又裁判模型答案，因此相关偏好或语义错误可能在专家验证后仍然保留。
  2. 复杂度统计的是合并事实数量，并不保证实际推理深度；额外上下文会让部分二级问题比一级问题更少歧义，二元方面评分也不给部分分。
  3. 数据只覆盖 6,500 张胃肠内镜图像，继承来源类别不平衡，并采用非商业许可，限制临床、跨专科和商业泛化。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
• Use the public records for medical VLM supervised fine-tuning or complexity-aware curricula, preserving original atomic QA provenance so performance can be separated by source class and composition depth.
  • Recreate the transformed setting with the released seed and scripts, then audit a stratified sample for semantic preservation, expert-label quality, image leakage, and judge disagreement. Report per-class failures alongside aggregate text metrics.

• 可用公开记录进行医学视觉语言模型监督微调或复杂度课程学习，并保留原始问答来源，从而按来源类别和组合深度拆分性能。
  • 可用公开种子与脚本重建变换设置，再分层审计语义保持、专家标签质量、图像泄漏和裁判分歧。报告应同时给出逐类别失败与总文字指标。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Positioning: Kvasir-VQA-x1 is an open multimodal instruction release with a robustness benchmark layered on the same clinical records.
  • Data object: each record exposes the image, complexity, merged question, naturalized answer, original atomic QAs, clinical classes, and image id.
  • Author and selector: Qwen3-30B-A3B composes the text; trivial-item removal, structural checks, ambiguity screening, and clinical experts select the release.
  • Evidence anchor: LoRA fine-tuning produces large gains over base MedGemma and Qwen2.5-VL, while transformed-data variants remain stable across clean and perturbed validation images.
  • Reuse decision: suitable for GI VQA fine-tuning and robustness audits after checking teacher-judge correlation, source-image coverage, complexity validity, and non-commercial terms.

• 定位：这是开放多模态指令数据发布，并在同一临床记录上叠加鲁棒性基准。
  • 数据对象：每条记录暴露图像、复杂度、合并问题、自然化答案、原始问答、临床类别和图像编号。
  • 生成与选择：大模型组合文本；琐碎项删除、结构检查、歧义筛查和临床专家共同决定保留。
  • 证据锚点：低秩微调相对两个基础模型产生大幅增益，使用变换数据训练的版本在干净和扰动图像间保持稳定。
  • 复用决定：适合胃肠视觉问答微调与鲁棒性审计，但应先检查教师与裁判相关性、来源图像覆盖、复杂度有效性和非商业条款。
